description: Collect Product Hunt launches, products, comments and reviews without a Product Hunt account or API token.

categorySlugs.description: Categories for mode=category, e.g. `ai-code-editors`, `productivity`, or a full `/categories/...` URL.
categorySlugs.title: Category slugs or URLs

date.description: Optional date for mode=leaderboard, in YYYY-MM-DD form. The daily period uses the exact day; weekly, monthly and yearly use that day's ISO week, month or year. Defaults to today.
date.title: Leaderboard date

featuredOnly.description: Keep only launches that Product Hunt selected for the homepage.
featuredOnly.title: Featured launches only

from.description: Optional first day for mode=dailyRange, in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to the `to` date, or yesterday.
from.title: From date

includeComments.description: Attach the discussion thread (comments and nested replies) to each launch. Adds one or more requests per launch.
includeComments.title: Include comments and replies

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full launch page for description, hunter, makers, media, website, pricing, ranks and review score. Turn off for a faster, lighter feed.
includeDetails.title: Include launch and product details

includeHistory.description: Attach every earlier launch from the same product, newest first.
includeHistory.title: Include launch history

includeReviews.description: Attach Product Hunt's detailed reviews, ratings, pros and cons to each launch. Adds one request per 10 reviews.
includeReviews.title: Include product reviews

maxComments.description: Used when `includeComments` is on. Comments are read 20 threads per page, including replies, and capped at this number.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per launch

maxItems.description: Stop after this many launch records. One record is one launch (comments and reviews stay attached to it).
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPages.description: Page cap per feed, topic, category, search query, product history, comment thread or review feed. A full Product Hunt day is about 40-60 pages of 20 launches.
maxPages.title: Maximum pages per source

maxReviews.description: Used when `includeReviews` is on. Reviews are read 10 per page and capped at this number.
maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per product

mode.description: Pick the launch feed, a leaderboard period, a date range, a topic, a category, a keyword search, specific products, or specific launches.
mode.title: What to scrape

period.description: Used when mode is `leaderboard`. Daily = one day, weekly = ISO week, monthly = calendar month, yearly = calendar year.
period.title: Leaderboard period

postIds.description: Launches for mode=launch, e.g. `strawberry-1-0`, or full `https://www.producthunt.com/products/...?launch=...` URLs.
postIds.title: Launch slugs or URLs

productSlugs.description: Products for mode=product, e.g. `notion`, `figma`, or full `https://www.producthunt.com/products/...` URLs. Each product's latest launch is returned.
productSlugs.title: Product slugs or URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy; add one only if Product Hunt blocks your network or you need a specific location.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword for mode=search, e.g. `notion`, `ai browser`, `invoice`. Product Hunt searches products, then the actor resolves each product's latest launch.
searchQuery.title: Search query

to.description: Optional last day for mode=dailyRange, in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to the `from` date, or yesterday.
to.title: To date

topicSlugs.description: Topics for mode=topic, e.g. `artificial-intelligence`, `developer-tools`, or a full `/topics/...` URL.
topicSlugs.title: Topic slugs or URLs

title: Product Hunt Scraper Input
